caption: The drawing depicts two embroidered objects placed side by side on a plain, light beige background. Both objects have a similar shape resembling a pouch or panel with rounded edges and are bordered with a scalloped trim in a brownish-gold color, with tufts or tassels visible at the bottom corners. The object on the left features an urn or vase in shades of dull gold with a yellowish flower at its center; to its sides are pink and red flowers with green highlights, and two blue flowers near the base on either side. The object on the right displays a blue urn or vase from which rise two yellow-green leafy heart-shaped motifs with floral patterns, flanked by blue flowers on either side and a larger blue flower at the top center. The composition is symmetrical for each object and uses muted, earthy tones with blue, gold, yellow, pink, and green embroidery thread. In the bottom right area of the drawing, the text "ISABELLA RUTH DOERFLER" is stamped in capital letters.
title: Embroidered Purse
